description: This file defines a Spring service class that handles the undo operation for approval of fixed deposit account applications in the Fineract lending platform. It implements a command handler interface and delegates the undo action to a service layer.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountApplicationApprovalUndoCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring @Service class that handles the undo of application approval for fixed deposit accounts by implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the undo approval command by delegating to the depositAccountWritePlatformService to perform the undo operation, passing the entity ID, command, and deposit account type.
